reason: B directly targets a high-temperature wear mechanism—formation and renewal of a protective tribo-oxide—and proposes atmosphere-controlled testing with measurable oxide and wear outcomes. A largely extrapolates room-temperature wear results from a different, thermally sprayed CoCrFeNiMn alloy to FeNiCrCoCu and therefore does not adequately support its specific 500 °C microstructure or high-temperature wear claim.
